{{Quote|We tried everything else on this guy, Jos&mdash;macromolecular regeneration, nanocell implants, maser cauterization&mdash;nothing worked.|Zan Yant, to Jos Vondar, about N'do Maetrecis's ailment|<ref name="Battle Surgeons">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>}}
'''Nanocell implants''' were a type of medical [[Nanotechnology/Legends|nanotechnology]] in use by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Battle Surgeons" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'' to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> the Republic's [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[N'do Maetrecis]] contracted an unknown [[Disease/Legends|disease]] from the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|274|Maetrecis, N'do}}</ref> after receiving a [[Heart/Legends|heart]] transplant from [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|Republic Mobile Surgical Unit]] personnel. Medical staff tried using nanocell implants and other medical interventions to cure him, though each was unsuccessful and the [[Officer/Legends|officer's]] state deteriorated. Maetrecis ultimately only recovered after [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Zan Yant]] began giving him illegal dosages of the healing [[Plant/Legends|plant]] [[Bota/Legends|bota]], which the surgeon [[Jos Vondar]] scolded his colleague for.<ref name="Battle Surgeons" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nanocell implants were mentioned in the [[2004]] novel ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', which was written by by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]] as the first installment of the [[MedStar Duology]].<ref name="Battle Surgeons" />
